column7: Review of #3631: a failed repair or generation-bump transaction reset the integrity checker baseline to empty, so the next tick adopted whatever the catalog then showed as a fresh baseline. A body replaced, a repair that could not commit, and the body restored before the next tick (by the tamperer, or by another replica booting) left every warm cache authorizing a revoked permission with nothing left to detect (fail open). The checker now keeps a pending flag that only a committed repair plus a clean re-read clears, and every tick repairs and bumps while it is set.
